name: [NEW] Camera Tower Defense
desc:
The last update... A lot of towers and reworks have been dropped. Goodbye CTD.

🏆Fight against toilets using your units, and achieve victory across different chapters. Gather your strongest!🏆
⬆️Upgrade your towers to buff their statistics and change their models visually.⬆️
🪙Buy towers in the Shop with your credits you earn from winning or losing chapters.🪙

Warning: This game is in Alpha Stage. Many things are subject to change, and bugs may be present..
